# Billing

Learn about MrScraper's subscription plans, token usage, billing cycles.

MrScraper offers flexible subscription plans designed for different usage levels, from individual developers testing the platform to enterprise teams running large-scale scraping operations. All plans include access to our AI-powered scraping agents, stealth browser technology, and residential proxies (on applicable plans).

## Available Plans

### Free

Perfect for testing and small projects.

| Feature | Allocation |
|---|---|
| **API Tokens** | 100 tokens |
| **Concurrent Requests** | 10 |
| **Residential Proxies** | ❌ |
| **Priority Email Support** | ❌ |
| **Dedicated Account Manager** | ❌ |

Free Plan Limitations

## Plan Features

### Concurrent Requests

Concurrent requests represent how many scraping operations MrScraper can process for you simultaneously. Your plan determines this limit.

| Plan | Concurrent Requests |
|---|---|
| Free | 10 |
| Standard | 50 |
| Pro | 100 |
| Enterprise | Custom |

**What happens when you exceed the limit?**

When you reach your concurrent request limit, additional scraping jobs wait in a queue until a slot becomes available. Upgrading to a higher plan increases your concurrency, allowing faster processing of bulk operations.

### Residential Proxies

Residential proxies provide IP addresses from real residential networks, helping you bypass anti-scraping measures and access geo-restricted content.

**Available on:**

- ✅ Standard plan and above
- ❌ Free plan
**Benefits:**

- Higher success rates on protected sites
- Geo-targeting capabilities
- Improved reliability
- Better CAPTCHA handling

### Priority Email Support

Get faster response times and dedicated assistance from our support team.

**Available on:**

- ✅ Standard plan and above
- ❌ Free plan

### Dedicated Account Manager

Work directly with a dedicated account manager who understands your use case and can provide strategic guidance.

**Available on:**

- ✅ Pro plan and above
- ❌ Free and Standard
**Benefits:**

- Strategic scraping advice
- Configuration optimization
- Direct escalation path
- Quarterly business reviews (Enterprise)

## Billing Cycle

### How Token Allocation Works

**Monthly Plans:**

- Tokens reset on your monthly renewal date
- Full token allotment available at the start of each cycle
- Unused tokens do **not** roll over to the next month
**Annual Plans:**

- Billed once per year
- Tokens still reset **monthly** on your renewal date
- 20% discount on total cost
- Unused tokens do **not** roll over

### Example Timeline

If you subscribe to Scraper Pro on **January 15th**:

| Date | Event | Token Balance |
|---|---|---|
| Jan 15 | Subscription starts | 1,000,000 tokens |
| Jan 31 | Used 600,000 tokens | 400,000 tokens |
| Feb 15 | Billing cycle renews | 1,000,000 tokens (reset) |

Important

## Tracking Your Usage

Monitor your token consumption and billing information through multiple channels:

- Dashboard: View real-time usage in your [account API token dashboard](https://app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens)
- API Endpoints: Track usage programmatically using our [Analytics API](/docs/api/v3/analytic/status)

## Invoices and Receipts

To access the invoices or receipts of your account:

1. Go to **Account Profile** → **Manage Billing**
2. You’ll be redirected to Stripe
3. Under **Invoice History**, select the **billing** record
4. Click **Download** to get the invoice or receipt
